project_type: React + Vite SPA with Firebase Firestore backend
build_system: Vite (vite build), npm for package management
test_framework: None configured (no test files or test dependencies found)
test_command: npm run build (no unit tests exist - build success is the verification)
verification_instructions: Run npm run build to confirm no compilation errors. Manually verify the sync button appears in AdminPage and the real-time listener logic is correctly structured.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access available. Node.js v22 available via nvm.
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md found. Follow existing code patterns: ES module imports, react-hot-toast for notifications, Firebase Firestore for data, functional components with hooks.
key_patterns: Services in src/services/ export async functions that interact with Firestore. Components use useState/useEffect hooks. Toast notifications via react-hot-toast. Admin authentication via localStorage flag. Catalog data stored in single Firestore doc 'catalog/current' with {products: [...], updatedAt: timestamp}. Employee caching uses localStorage key 'pricelist_catalog_cache' with 5-min TTL. ProductEditor handles create/update/delete and calls onProductsChanged callback. AdminPage orchestrates all admin sections.
directory_structure: src/services/ - Firebase service modules (productService, auditService, etc). src/components/ - React UI components. src/pages/ - Page-level components (AdminPage, HomePage). src/constants/ - Configuration (Firebase config, admin password). src/utils/ - Utility functions (search, CSV, cloudinary).
